<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/enqueue_enrichment"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Queue prospects for LinkedIn or domain enrichment. Creates an enrichment run,
updates prospect statuses, and optionally publishes to SQS queue.

**Side Effects:**
- Creates document in `enrichment_runs` collection
- Updates each prospect's enrichment status and timestamps
- Adds listTag to prospect's list_ids array
- Publishes message to SQS (if queue URL configured)
- Records pricing transaction (if sessionId provided)
- Triggers local enrichment scripts (if LOCAL_ENRICHMENT=1)
